evidence_paraphrase: The Roche collaboration began in 2022. A different party made a private acquisition proposal in April 2023, then withdrew in June; Roche declined acquisition discussions at that time. The August 2023 Astellas financing conveyed observer, information and program rights rather than company control. Roche acquisition proposals and negotiations began in August 2024, followed by further bargaining and competing-party outreach. Final approval and execution occurred November 25, with the disclosed public announcement November 26. Thus January 1 preceded any executed or publicly definitive company-sale agreement in the complete disclosed chronology.
